translations.web: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.
translations.bsb: For they cannot sleep unless they do evil; they are deprived of slumber until they make someone fall.
translations.kjv: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
translations.asv: For they sleep not, except they do evil; And their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
